title: From Yelling to Smiling: Trump and Zelenskyy Team Up to Build Missiles!
summary: Imagine two kids who used to argue in the lunchroom suddenly becoming best friends and building a super-cool LEGO fortress together. That's kind of what just happened with U.S. President Donald Trump and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy! They had a "good meeting" at the White House on Tuesday, July 28, 2026. This is a big change from last year, when Trump and his vice president yelled at Zelenskyy in front of cameras, saying he wasn't thankful enough. Now, they're talking about making Patriot missiles right in Ukraine. Patriots are super-important because they can shoot down enemy planes and missiles from the sky. Zelenskyy said, "We talked with the president about licences to produce Patriot interceptor missiles in Ukraine." That means Ukraine could build its own defense weapons, with help from American companies. They also talked about working together on drones. Ukraine is already making up to 7 million small attack drones this year! The U.S. is way behind, with only about 200,000 ordered. So teaming up could help both countries. The meeting lasted just over an hour, and a White House spokesperson said it was "positive and productive." Zelenskyy was in the U.S. for a senator's funeral, but he also met with other leaders to push for peace. The war with Russia has been going on for more than four years. Zelenskyy said his top goal is "anti-ballistic defence" – stopping missiles – and bringing peace closer. It's like two former rivals deciding to share their best toys to protect the playground.
why_it_matters: Countries teaming up can make both stronger, just like when you share ideas on a group project at school.

background_read: Ukraine has been fighting a war with Russia since 2014, when Russia took over the region of Crimea.
The United States and many other countries have been sending weapons and money to help Ukraine defend itself.
Trump became U.S. president again in 2025, and he has sometimes disagreed with Zelenskyy in the past.
Article_Structure: WHO: U.S. President Donald Trump and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy
WHAT: They met to discuss building Patriot interceptor missiles and drones together in Ukraine.
WHERE: At the White House in Washington, D.C.
WHY: Ukraine wants better defence against Russian attacks, and the U.S. can gain from Ukraine's advanced drone factories.

perspectives.description: They think making missiles together helps Ukraine defend itself and gives the U.S. a chance to learn from Ukraine's fast drone building.
Some worry that building American weapons in another country could let secrets fall into the wrong hands or make Russia angrier.
They see this as a surprising friendship after a public argument and are watching to see if the plan actually happens.
